The live create leg read the projected title back exactly as rendered (decision D81, PR #313).

rpSource: merged PR #515 body (gh pr view), structure only — the bytes stay in the recorded artifact
citation: The identity contract: the body is the claim marker (component, line, target, plan fingerprint) plus the plan render — parseable identity content, never a title/label pattern (compatibility matrix row F2, detect & update; src/app/release-pr.ts §1). Decision D81 proves the marker live: the created draft was adopted by its marker alone and a tampered body was refused as plan-conflict without a rewrite. Release-please's body is a bot-authored changelog carrier — a generated-by header and a version heading, no parseable identity claim.

rcSource: renderReleasePRProjection labels (the constant, state-free organizational label)
citation: Compatibility matrix row F3 (pending-state labels `autorelease: pending`): RELEASE-PLEASE QUIRK deliberately not adopted — label-based state is replaced by claim/attempt identity in ledger refs. Observed on all three consumers' merged release PRs: `autorelease: tagged` rides alongside organizational labels (`documentation`, `size/s`); release-craft's projection carries the one constant organizational label `release-craft`.

On loom and archkeep the absent `Documentation` header is the selected-changes membership law rendered: the plan selects no docs commits, so the declared Documentation section has nothing to render (row A).
